component.name: curfewd (Timekpr-nExT Control Panel)
component.summary: Track and control computer usage of user accounts

description.p: curfewd is a maintained drop-in fork of Timekpr-nExT that tracks and controls the computer usage of your user accounts. You can limit daily, weekly, and monthly usage and configure curfew hours with reliable screen locking across Cinnamon, XFCE, MATE, GNOME, and KDE Plasma.
This may be used for parental control to limit the amount of screen time a child spends in front of the computer.
Please report any bugs to curfewd’s issue tracker on GitHub at: https://github.com/csmende/curfewd/issues
